headline: Title Fight Off
caption:
UPDATE: Anastasia Nikolakakos vs. Chihiro Sawada for ONE gold is off.
Rebook it or new opponent? 👇

ONE Championship says an injury to Nikolakakos postponed the vacant women's atomweight MMA title fight at ONE Samurai 6 in Yokohama on Dec 2. No new date yet; Wajima vs. Siasarani in kickboxing now headlines.

🔥 Hot take: Sawada vs. Nikolakakos is worth the wait.
Change my mind.
question: Rebook or new foe?
hot_take: Sawada vs. Nikolakakos is *worth* the wait.

v2.story: An injury to Nikolakakos postpones her vacant ONE title fight with Sawada.
